deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

src/kotoba/swift/iso20022.cljk.reason: AWAI-3228: ISO 20022 output conforms to the published XSDs for the modeled subset: compact emission (no whitespace around values), ReqdExctnDt/Dt, pacs.008 Dbtr/DbtrAcct/DbtrAgt order, parse-xml keeps value text, and validate-iso20022 checks XSD order/occurrence/value facets; builders return nil for documents it rejects.

test/kotoba/swift/iso20022_test.cljk.reason: AWAI-3228: regression tests for the XSD findings K1-K4 (whitespace, ReqdExctnDt choice, element order, validator strictness and value facets); the pretty-print expectation is replaced by the compact form.

README.md.reason: AWAI-3228: describe compact emission and the XSD-subset validation, and point to conformance/README.md.

docs/adr/0001-real-wire-format.md.reason: AWAI-3228: the 'no XSD validation' limitation now states what validate-iso20022 checks and where the XSD conformance evidence is.
